renderer: Unmodified Sky native window captures; no montage or synthetic gameplay data used as in-game evidence
scope: Six reference layouts inspected in real zone scenes across alpha4 iterations. Final Elwynn combat with six acquired spells and racial, live proc resource, XP and counters. Native level choices retain priority. Independent dock 65% and combined map/identity 70% inspected together. Native options restored and test game closed. Captures span corrections; only the declared scope is certified.
notCertified: Every capture matching final package bytes
Freshness of the boss in the intermediate Alternative capture after Rejouer
finalGameState: Closed after test run, Auto / Minimaliste selected; Elwynn Complete dock/map test scales restored to 100%.
